events.text: You get invited to an open-mic night. If you do well, people start asking for your number instead of your name.

choices.label: Play the piece you practiced most
choices.resultText: You nail the rhythm and earn small tips. Someone nearby says, 'You should really be charging for this.'

choices.label: Try something risky and new
choices.resultText: It is not perfect, but it is memorable. Your confidence grows even if the crowd is split.

choices.label: Back out at the last second
choices.resultText: You escape embarrassment, but you lose momentum. You still have the 'what if' in your head.

events.text: A local market stall asks if you can help with a 'taster' batch. They want something bold, not safe.

choices.label: Offer your signature dish
choices.resultText: People line up for seconds. One regular tells the stall owner you 'cook like you care about flavor.'

choices.label: Go cheaper and faster to avoid risk
choices.resultText: The batch sells out, but it is forgettable. Still, steady work is steady progress.

choices.label: Over-season and ignore feedback
choices.resultText: You get a polite complaint. The stall asks for a refund, and you feel the lesson settle in.

events.text: A sparring day turns into more than drills. Someone challenges you to a 'friendly' match that feels anything but friendly.

choices.label: Match their intensity and learn fast
choices.resultText: You survive the hard rounds and leave with new timing. The coach looks impressed.

choices.label: Focus on defense and outlast them
choices.resultText: You avoid unnecessary damage. People respect your discipline, and your confidence stays clean.

choices.label: Showboat for approval
choices.resultText: You win the moment and lose the lesson. The hype ends the second you get hurt.

events.text: At a community 'fix it' night, someone brings a broken app and expects miracles in one afternoon.

choices.label: Debug patiently and explain your steps
choices.resultText: They do not just leave impressed - they remember you for future work.

choices.label: Rush the solution and hope it holds
choices.resultText: It works for a week. Then the same user comes back angry, and you learn what 'quality' costs.

choices.label: Refuse the request to avoid drama
choices.resultText: You protect your time. The right people later notice you didn't fold under pressure.

events.text: You submit a short piece to a small publication. The wait is where your nerves start writing their own story.

choices.label: Revise once more before sending
choices.resultText: The editor responds fast. They want another draft next month.

choices.label: Send it as-is and accept the risk
choices.resultText: The piece is 'good' rather than perfect. You still feel proud because you shipped it.

choices.label: Delete it and pretend you never wrote
choices.resultText: You protect your ego, but you also starve your ambition.
